description: Rete in Fibra Ottica - WMS is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizisct.regione.vda.it. The map shows the route taken by the regionally-owned fibre optic network in the Next Generation Network plan, with the aim of reducing the digital divide in the Aosta Valley. The infrastructure shall be made available to telecommunications operators for the provision of ultra-broadband services to end-users. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Optical Fiber Network - WMS" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
